<!-- Write the title and body in English. See https://github.com/takahirox/webgpu-devtools/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md -->

## Summary

Explain the problem and the focused changes that address it.

## Outcome

Describe the resulting behavior, including before/after examples when useful.

## Validation

List checks actually performed and their results. Report failures, skipped checks, and unperformed checks with reasons. Choose checks appropriate to the changed files and existing repository tooling; documentation-only changes do not require runtime or device tests.

## Related Issues

Link the source Issue and any related Issues. Use `Closes #...` only when this PR fully addresses that Issue; describe any intentional partial scope.

## Required post-merge verification

List genuinely required post-merge checks separately, marked pending until performed, or state that none are required. Do not claim deployment or publication succeeded based on pre-merge validation.
